item.title: John Couey Hid Jessica Lunsford Across The Street
item.description: Nine-year-old Jessica Lunsford disappeared from her Homosassa, Florida, home in 2005. Her fingerprints and DNA were found in John Couey’s nearby trailer. Convicted of her kidnapping and murder in 2007, he was sentenced to death and died in custody in 2009.

item.title: Evelyn Boswell Was Found In Her Mother’s Old Playhouse
item.description: Tennessee toddler Evelyn Boswell was reported missing in February 2020, months after she was last seen. Investigators found her remains in her mother’s childhood playhouse. Megan Boswell was convicted of murder in 2025 and sentenced to life plus 33 years.

item.title: Casey Anthony Calls Herself A Legal Advocate On TikTok
item.description: Casey Anthony joined TikTok in March 2025, calling herself a legal advocate and saying she wanted to speak for her daughter, Caylee. She was acquitted in 2011 of murdering Caylee but convicted of lying to investigators.

item.title: Daisy Coleman Learned Her Case Was Dropped On Facebook
item.description: Daisy Coleman reported a sexual assault at 14 in Missouri, then learned on Facebook that charges had been dropped. Matthew Barnett pleaded guilty to misdemeanor child endangerment in 2014. Coleman later co-founded SafeBAE to support survivors before her death at 23 in 2020.
